privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.lead: Your trust matters more than any project. This policy explains, in plain language, what personal data we collect, why, how long we keep it and the rights you have — under the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), Greek law and the Israeli Privacy Protection Law, 5741-1981, as amended (including Amendment 13).

sections.h: 1. Who is responsible for your data

blocks.p: The controller of personal data processed through modera-group.com is Modera Group, 2 Plateia Eleftherias, 73132 Chania, Crete, Greece, tax no. EL802555027 (“Modera”, “we”, “us”).

For any privacy question or request, contact us at support@modera-group.com or +30 698 392 4820. We are not required to appoint a Data Protection Officer; our management handles privacy matters directly.

ul: We do not use advertising cookies, tracking pixels or third-party analytics.
We do not sell, rent or trade personal data — ever.
Our fonts and images are hosted on our own server, so simply visiting the site sends no data to Google or other third parties.
External content such as Google Maps loads only if you allow it.
Optional cookies are off until you switch them on, and we respect the Global Privacy Control signal.
Enquiry data is used only to answer you and is deleted after 24 months unless we work together.

blocks.p: Information you give us. When you use the contact form, email, call or message us on WhatsApp: your name, email address, phone number, country of residence, details about your project (type, service, budget range, stage) and anything you choose to write in your message, together with the date and language of your enquiry and a record of the consent you gave.

Technical data. Like every website, our hosting server automatically records basic technical information when pages are requested: IP address, date and time, page requested, browser type and referring page. These server logs are used only for security and to keep the site running, and are deleted or rotated after a short period.

Data stored on your device. We store a small number of settings in your browser (your privacy choices, accessibility settings and — only with your permission — your language). Details are in our cookie policy.

We do not knowingly collect special categories of data (such as health, religion or political views) and ask you not to send them. Our website is not directed at children under 16 and we do not knowingly collect their data.

blocks.p: Under Israeli law, you are not legally required to provide any personal data. Providing it is voluntary — however, without your name and a way to contact you we cannot respond to your enquiry. We make no decisions about you based solely on automated processing, including profiling.
Only people within Modera who need your data to help you can access it. We share data outside Modera only in these cases:

ul: Hosting provider — our website, contact form and mailbox run on servers of our hosting provider, Jetserver, located in Israel, acting as our processor under a data-processing agreement.
Google — only if you choose to load the map, Google receives your IP address and may set cookies under its own privacy policy. Google LLC is certified under the EU–US Data Privacy Framework.
Professional advisers and partners — lawyers, accountants, engineers or our strategic partner Sivan Invest Group, only where needed for your project and with your knowledge.
Authorities — where we are legally required to, for example tax authorities or courts.

blocks.p: We never sell personal data or share it for third-party advertising.

Our hosting is located in Israel, which the European Commission recognises as providing an adequate level of data protection (adequacy decision 2011/61/EU, confirmed in 2024). Where data is transferred to other countries outside the European Economic Area, we rely on an adequacy decision or the European Commission’s Standard Contractual Clauses.

ul: Enquiries that do not lead to a contract: up to 24 months, then deleted.
Client and contract records: for the duration of the contract and afterwards for as long as Greek tax, accounting and construction law requires (generally up to 10 years).
Marketing consent: until you unsubscribe or withdraw consent.
Server logs: for a short period for security purposes, then deleted or rotated.
Privacy choices stored in your browser: 12 months, after which we ask again.

blocks.p: Depending on the law that applies to you, you have the right to:

ul: Access the personal data we hold about you and receive a copy;
Correct inaccurate or incomplete data;
Delete your data (“right to be forgotten”);
Restrict or object to certain processing, including direct marketing at any time;
Data portability — receive your data in a structured, machine-readable format;
Withdraw consent at any time, without affecting processing carried out before withdrawal — for cookies, use “Cookie settings” at the bottom of every page;
Under the Israeli Privacy Protection Law, to review information about you held in a database (section 13) and to request its correction or deletion (section 14).

blocks.p: To exercise any right, email support@modera-group.com. We may ask you to confirm your identity. We reply within one month (extendable by two further months for complex requests, in which case we will tell you), and free of charge.

You also have the right to complain to a supervisory authority: in Greece, the Hellenic Data Protection Authority (www.dpa.gr); in Israel, the Privacy Protection Authority (www.gov.il/en/departments/the_privacy_protection_authority); or the authority in the EU country where you live or work. We would appreciate the chance to resolve any concern with you first.

We use HTTPS encryption across the entire site, store enquiries outside the public web directory with restricted access, limit access to authorised staff, keep software up to date and protect forms against automated abuse. No system is completely secure; if a breach affecting your rights were to occur, we would notify the competent authority and, where required, you, within the time limits set by law.
We may update this policy when our services or the law change. The date at the top shows the latest version. If changes are significant, we will ask for your consent again where required.

cookies.title: Cookie policy
cookies.lead: This website is designed to be private by default. It uses no advertising or tracking cookies. Optional storage is switched off until you choose otherwise, and you can change your choices at any time.

sections.h: What are cookies and local storage?

blocks.p: Cookies and local storage are small pieces of information that a website saves in your browser. Some are essential for a site to work; others remember preferences or enable third-party content. Under the GDPR and the ePrivacy rules (Greek Law 3471/2006), anything that is not strictly necessary requires your prior consent.

blocks.p: Our own items are stored as local storage in your browser, are never sent to our server and contain no identifiers. We do not currently use any statistics or advertising tools. If we introduce statistics in the future, they will remain off until you allow them.

Use Cookie settings at the bottom of every page to review or withdraw your consent at any time. When you withdraw consent, we delete the related items from your browser immediately. You can also delete all site data through your browser settings.
We honour the Global Privacy Control (GPC) signal: if your browser sends it, optional categories stay off.

accessibility.title: Accessibility statement
accessibility.lead: We want everyone — including people with disabilities and older users — to be able to use our website easily and independently. Accessibility is part of how we design and build, not an afterthought.

blocks.p: This website has been designed and developed to conform to the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.1, level AA, which also covers the requirements of Israeli Standard SI 5568 under the Equal Rights for Persons with Disabilities (Service Accessibility Adjustments) Regulations, 5773-2013, and the European standard EN 301 549.

ul: Semantic structure with clear headings, landmarks and a “Skip to content” link;
Full keyboard navigation with a clearly visible focus indicator;
Text alternatives for meaningful images; decorative images are hidden from screen readers;
Colour contrast that meets or exceeds AA ratios, and information never conveyed by colour alone;
Responsive layout that works at 200% zoom and on any screen size;
Forms with visible labels, clear error messages and status announcements for screen readers;
Videos have no sound, can be paused, and stop automatically when “reduce motion” is enabled;
Animations respect your device’s “reduce motion” setting;
Charts include their values as text;
Each language version is correctly marked so screen readers pronounce it properly.

blocks.p: Select the accessibility button (the figure icon at the bottom of the screen) to open the accessibility panel. It lets you enlarge text, switch to high contrast, stop animations and videos, highlight links, use a more readable font, increase text spacing and enlarge the cursor. Your settings are saved only on your device.

We test regularly with keyboard, screen readers (VoiceOver, NVDA) and automated tools. Some third-party content, such as the embedded Google Map, is outside our full control; our address and directions are always available as text on the contact page. If you find any barrier, please tell us — we will fix it.
If you have difficulty using any part of the website, or would like information in an alternative format, contact our accessibility coordinator:

ul: Accessibility coordinator, Modera Group
Email: support@modera-group.com
Phone / WhatsApp: +30 698 392 4820
Address: 2 Plateia Eleftherias, 73132 Chania, Crete, Greece

blocks.p: Please describe the problem and the page concerned. We aim to respond within 5 business days. Our office services can also be provided by phone, email or WhatsApp; for information about physical access to our office, please contact us before your visit.
